title: tectaria incisa f. vivipara
intro: Tectaria incisa f. vivipara, commonly known as the Viviparous Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is known for its unique ability to produce live offspring, giving it its viviparous name. The health benefits of Tectaria incisa f. vivipara include its potential to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and promoting wound healing.
